canonical_project: Data Center 1 - Bon Espoir / Bon Espoir Data Centre
notes: Uptime Institute lists Cable & Wireless (Seychelles) Limited's Data Center 1 - Bon Espoir in Anse Boileau, Seychelles. Seychelles Nation reported Cable & Wireless inaugurated the Bon Espoir Data Centre on 2024-11-22; SBC also reported the data centre is based at Bon Espoir, Montagne Posee. Capacity not disclosed in public sources found.
